name: @arizeai/oxlint-plugin-jev
description: oxlint JS plugin that asks TypeSafe's jev whether Phoenix / OpenInference / OpenTelemetry usage follows the guidance in Phoenix's shipped agent skills
author: oss@arize.com

scripts.build: node scripts/copy-skills.mjs && tsc && node dist/verifyGuidance.js && chmod 755 dist/bin.js
scripts.demo: pnpm run build && cd ../.. && OXLINT_JEV_MODE=${OXLINT_JEV_MODE:-record} oxlint -c packages/oxlint-plugin-jev/demo.oxlintrc.json packages/oxlint-plugin-jev/fixtures examples/apps packages/phoenix-otel/examples
